sources.articleTitle: ‘I feel I have won the Olympic gold once again’: MM Somaya gets medal back
Bengaluru police recover M.M. Somaya’s 1980 Olympic gold medal, seven other international medals; two arrested

headline: Bengaluru Police Recover Stolen Olympic Gold Medal From Hockey Star
seoTitle: Bengaluru Police Recover Stolen Olympic Gold Medal
metaDescription: Police in Bengaluru have retrieved an Olympic gold medal and other sports items stolen from former Indian hockey captain M.M. Somaya's residence.
aiSummaryBullets: Bengaluru police apprehended two suspects in connection with the theft of an Olympic gold medal.
The recovered items include the 1980 gold medal, seven additional international medals, and various sporting equipment.
Authorities also seized a traditional Kodava dagger and a vehicle allegedly utilized during the commission of the crime.
aiContextParagraph: The Bengaluru police have successfully recovered an Olympic gold medal belonging to former Indian hockey team captain M.M. Somaya, which had been reported stolen from his residence. The investigation led to the arrest of two individuals, despite initial challenges regarding a lack of evidence. Beyond the 1980 Olympic gold medal, the recovered property includes seven other international medals, a professional camera, an Olympic kit bag, and a traditional Kodava dagger. Law enforcement officials also identified and secured the two-wheeler vehicle suspected of being used by the perpetrators during the theft. Following the recovery, the former athlete expressed his relief and appreciation for the police's commitment to the case, noting the significant emotional value the medals hold for his career. This incident marks a notable resolution in local law enforcement efforts to track down stolen sporting memorabilia.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained moderate visibility across regional Indian media outlets due to the recovery of a significant sports trophy and the successful police investigation.
